Predictability is middling — structured signal and irregular noise are balanced. The series reads as ambiguous by the ADF/KPSS tests. A few outliers stand out (1 points, ~1% of the sample). Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau -0.138), which favours a robust combination.

decision.justification: Selected 'weighted weighted by w2' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9963. Series context: trend strength 0.9997 and seasonal strength 1.0; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.138); 2 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.485.
